France Faces Debt Crisis Amid Protests and Economic Concerns

France is reportedly facing a potential debt crisis, with concerns escalating due to record debt levels and ongoing high school protests. Economic indicators suggest France's debt is riskier than that of 38% of the nation's company bonds. The situation has drawn global attention.
